datasets.name: ds_summary
queryLines:
SELECT CASE period WHEN 'after_training' THEN 'After training' ELSE 'Development, out of fold' END AS period_name, CASE WHEN model = 'Rainfall rule' THEN 'Rainfall rule' ELSE concat('FloodSense, ', lower(warning_level)) END AS warning_by, model_version, period_start, period_end,
       pub_alert_events, pub_alert_days,
       alerts_warned_before_pub, alerts_warned_before_pub_lo, alerts_warned_before_pub_hi,
       alert_mean_lead_min, alert_mean_lead_min_lo, alert_mean_lead_min_hi,
       flash_floods, floods_warned_before_pub, floods_warned_before_pub_lo, floods_warned_before_pub_hi,
       flood_mean_lead_min, pub_flood_warning_min,
       public_flood_warning_min, public_flood_warning_min_lo, public_flood_warning_min_hi,
       warnings, warnings_followed_by_alert, false_alarms_per_area_month, warned_hours_per_area_month
FROM scoreboard
ORDER BY period, model, warning_level DESC

datasets.name: ds_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT alerts_warned_before_pub, alert_mean_lead_min, floods_warned_before_pub, flash_floods,
       false_alarms_per_area_month, pub_alert_events, pub_flood_warning_min, public_flood_warning_min
FROM scoreboard
WHERE period = 'after_training' AND model = 'FloodSense' AND warning_level = 'Moderate or above'

datasets.name: ds_floods
queryLines:
SELECT CASE period WHEN 'after_training' THEN 'After training' ELSE 'Development, out of fold' END AS period_name,
       concat(date_format(flood_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), '  ', area) AS flood_label,
       flood_time, area,
       CASE WHEN judged THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No: posts lost or inputs missing' END AS counted,
       pub_first_alert, pub_warning_min, floodsense_warned_from, floodsense_lead_min,
       CASE WHEN floodsense_before_pub THEN 'Before PUB' WHEN floodsense_lead_min IS NOT NULL THEN 'After PUB'
            ELSE 'No warning' END AS floodsense_warned,
       public_warning_min, floodsense_tier_at_flood, floodsense_chance_at_flood,
       floodsense_peak_tier, floodsense_peak_chance, scored_by, rule_lead_min,
       CASE WHEN rule_before_pub THEN 'Before PUB' WHEN rule_lead_min IS NOT NULL THEN 'After PUB'
            ELSE 'No warning' END AS rule_warned
FROM scoreboard_floods
ORDER BY flood_time DESC

datasets.name: ds_area
queryLines:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT model, warning_level, area, count(*) AS warnings, count_if(followed_by_pub_alert) AS came_true,
         count_if(false_alarm) AS false_alarms, sum(hours_in_force) AS hours_warned
  FROM scoreboard_warnings
  WHERE period = 'after_training' AND judged
  GROUP BY ALL),
e AS (
  SELECT model, warning_level, area, count(*) AS pub_alert_events, count_if(warned_before_pub) AS warned_first,
         avg(coalesce(lead_min, 0)) AS mean_lead_min
  FROM scoreboard_events
  WHERE period = 'after_training' AND judged AND event_kind = 'pub_alert'
  GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT CASE WHEN model = 'Rainfall rule' THEN 'Rainfall rule' ELSE concat('FloodSense, ', lower(warning_level)) END AS warning_by, area,
       coalesce(warnings, 0) AS warnings, coalesce(came_true, 0) AS came_true,
       coalesce(false_alarms, 0) AS false_alarms, round(coalesce(hours_warned, 0), 1) AS hours_warned,
       coalesce(pub_alert_events, 0) AS pub_alert_events, coalesce(warned_first, 0) AS warned_first,
       coalesce(pub_alert_events, 0) - coalesce(warned_first, 0) AS not_warned_first,
       round(mean_lead_min, 1) AS mean_lead_min
FROM w FULL OUTER JOIN e USING (model, warning_level, area)
ORDER BY false_alarms DESC, warnings DESC

datasets.name: ds_alerts
queryLines:
SELECT alert_time, CAST(year(alert_time) AS STRING) AS year, area, alert_type, location, lat, lon,
       CASE WHEN kind = 'flash_flood' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_flood
FROM pub_alerts

datasets.name: ds_prone
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year AS STRING) AS year, hectares, change_ha, change_pct
FROM flood_prone_trend
ORDER BY year

datasets.name: ds_prone_kpi
queryLines:
SELECT max_by(hectares, year) AS hectares_latest, max(year) AS latest_year,
       round(max_by(hectares, year) - min_by(hectares, year), 1) AS change_ha, min(year) AS first_year
FROM flood_prone_trend

# FloodSense scoreboard

How often FloodSense warned before PUB's first flood alert, how early, and how often its warnings came to nothing. FloodSense is an earlier heads-up on top of PUB's alerts, not a replacement for them.

### After training

Storms from 20 Dec 2025 on, which the live FloodSense model never trained on. Here a warning is FloodSense at Moderate or above.

lines: **Event**: PUB alerts in one area at most an hour apart, roughly one storm.
**Warning**: every 5-minute rating at the warning level warns for the next hour, so a warning runs from its first rating until an hour after its last.
**Lead**: minutes from that first rating to PUB's first alert of the event (or to the flash flood).
**False alarm**: a warning with no PUB alert while it was in force.
**Out of fold**: before 20 Dec 2025, each storm was scored by a version of FloodSense trained without it.
**Judged**: events and warnings where PUB's posts or the model's inputs are missing are left out.
**Round 1 targets**: more than 80% of flash floods warned before PUB, 30 minutes of warning on average, and better than the rainfall rule on both lead time and false alarms.

## Every flash flood

PUB's own warning (its first alert of the storm, to the flood) beside FloodSense's lead and the rainfall rule's. No bar means no warning was in force. Floods before 20 Dec 2025 were scored out of fold.
